title: Latency and timeouts on billing-svc

detection.alert: billing-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-08-05 10:19-15:19: billing-svc: 321 of 427 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-05 10:19 and 2026-08-05 15:19 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.
error_templates: c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} replaced a join with one query per row (N+1); billing-db CPU saturated under peak traffic and requests timed out.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) queries the database inside the loop.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore the eager join at {file}:{line}; add a query-count assertion to the integration tests.

rca.macro: Deploy v4.41.0 of billing-svc replaced a join with one query per row (N+1); billing-db CPU saturated under peak traffic and requests timed out.
rca.micro: billing/invoice/InvoiceService.java:194 (InvoiceService.generate) queries the database inside the loop.
rca.remediation: Roll back billing-svc v4.41.0 -> v4.40.0; restore the eager join at billing/invoice/InvoiceService.java:194; add a query-count assertion to the integration tests.

action_items: Add a regression test covering InvoiceService.generate (billing/invoice/InvoiceService.java).
Alert on the error signature `slow request: <*> ms, <*> SQL queries`.
